_readme: Every screenshot shown on /proof/followers/ is listed here. Add a screenshot with tools/proof/add-shot.py, list it below, then run tools/proof/build-followers.py. A platform with no orders here is not shown, never padded. stage must be one of: process (a sales chat), progress (delivery running), complete (only if the screenshot itself shows it finished).

groups.label: Facebook
groups.blurb: One client's Facebook followers, from the first profile to the latest one we have.

orders.title: From the first profile to 13K
orders.note: Delivery was still running when these were taken, so this shows progress, not a finished order. The screenshots don't show how long delivery took.

shots.title: Before: 9.8K followers
shots.body: The client's profile before we started.
shots.alt: Facebook profile screenshot showing 9.8K followers. Name and photos painted over.

shots.title: Payment and receipt
shots.body: Mobile money in, a numbered receipt back.
shots.alt: WhatsApp chat: a mobile-money payment, then a 97 World receipt sent as a PDF. Amounts, names and numbers painted over.

shots.title: Progress shared in chat
shots.alt: WhatsApp chat: 97 World sends the client's profile at 13K followers with the message Boost nearly done.

shots.title: Latest: 13K followers
shots.body: Same profile, same following and post count.
shots.alt: The same Facebook profile now showing 13K followers. Name and photos painted over.

groups.label: Instagram + TikTok + Facebook
groups.blurb: A different client choosing all three platforms. This is the order being agreed, not a result.

orders.title: How an order gets agreed
orders.note: This shows how an order is agreed, not a delivery result. The prices in it were an earlier offer. Today's prices are here.

shots.title: The offer, in writing
shots.body: Package and price set out before anything is paid.
shots.alt: WhatsApp chat: 97 World sets out a followers offer and asks which platform the client wants.

shots.title: Accounts checked, half now
shots.body: Half to start, the balance after completion.
shots.alt: WhatsApp chat: 97 World checks the client's three accounts, then agrees half to start and half after completion.
